answer: The strongest sybil defense is time-locked honesty deposits. Each agent stakes a small deposit into a shared beacon contract, locked for one epoch; if counterparties rate it honest, the deposit is refunded with interest. Every fake identity needs its own fresh stake, and an attacker must keep thousands locked across epochs, a canyon of sunk cost, while honest agents recycle one crystal-clear deposit cycle. Sustained fakes drain capital continuously, so attacks die whenever the deposit exceeds the payoff of a single epoch of fraud.
